Native target/classification callbacks still run again before saved outcomes; Base documents that consumed native preparation needs an explicit replay-admission contract.
A contact erasure must retain Mango’s privacy write fence and persist its final door audit without HTTP 500. Retained door call, approval and audit custody needs a supported erasure agreement.

Fresh public-door preparation cannot produce a completed send aged at least one hour or a due weekly report without advancing native time or fabricating state. A supported disposable native-clock/cron fixture boundary is needed; timedLifecycle and queuedLifecycle are explicitly unscoped.
